Batch crawl stream emits both Page and Error events for mixed success/failure URLs

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "crawlberg"
engine_config = { 'max_concurrent' => 1 }
engine = Crawlberg.create_engine(engine_config.to_json)
urls = ['https://example.com/success1', 'https://example.com/fail', 'https://example.com/success2']
result = Crawlberg.batch_crawl_stream(engine, urls).to_a
puts result.inspect
```
